    How old are these prices?

    How these numbers work

    • Each price is one row of our price data, copied from the vendor page linked in its row, with the date we checked it.
    • Clip totals are the price per second × the clip length. A length longer than a model's longest single clip needs more than one clip, and the row says how many. Wan 3.0: up to 30s per clip (as stated in our price data). Kling 3.0: up to 15s per clip (as stated in our price data).
    • Credit-plan rows assumes every credit you pay for is used. Unused credits make the real cost per second higher. Rows labelled estimated are not list prices.
    • Plan or tier, resolution and audio are shown as the vendor states them. "Not listed" and "not stated" mean the vendor page does not say.
    • Rows are ordered by price per second only. Affiliate links never change the order.
    • This page rebuilds with every daily price check. If any row on it goes more than 7 days without a check, the page shows a notice and is hidden from search until it is re-checked. Oldest check on this page: Nov 26, 2026.
